08 / FAQ

Frequently asked questions.

Here's what to expect when working with ORVEN.

How much will my project cost?+

Every project is different. Once we understand what you need, we'll provide a quote based on the scope and requirements.

How long does a project take?+

It depends on the size and complexity of the project. We'll discuss the expected timeline with you before getting started.

Can I request changes during the project?+

Yes. We'll agree on the scope and review stages from the start, so feedback and revisions are handled clearly. Any additional work outside the agreed scope will be discussed first.

What happens after launch?+

We provide an agreed period of maintenance and support after delivery. Ongoing maintenance and additional changes can be arranged separately.
